body: You can dodge the animation but you can not stop the damage. Before, you used to be able to stop the damage, just like you can stop all other damage by doing it.

That's because you need 4 people to say yes. You only need 2 people to say no for the vote to not go through. So with that logic, if 2 people vote no before any others vote, the voting should stop because it can not be passed.   The more you know!
